member.name: M:JCass_Economics.Optimisers.MooraRanker.ValidateMooraInputsFiniteOrThrow(System.Double[0:,0:],System.Double[],System.Double[],System.Int32,System.Int32)
member.summary: Scans the MOORA input arrays for NaN or Infinity values and throws a support-actionable exception identifying the first offending cell. Without this guard the column-wise Euclidean normalisation silently produces all-NaN ranks and the caller's descending sort becomes a stable no-op, bypassing the consumer's weighting entirely.

members.member:
Gets the optimal project based on a specified criteria (either max-bcr or max-benefit) using Incremental-Benefit-Cost-Ratio principles. If there is no valid project based on parameter 'minimumAcceptableBCRatio', then Null is returned. Solid Code. Unit Tested.
First the list of candidate projects is reduced to only those on the Pareto Frontier using the IBCR technique
Next, the list of projects on the Pareto frontier is sorted based on the criteria specified in sortMethod and the best one is returned
